usage: ws_sim.py [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--gui] [--debug] [--sse-port SSE_PORT] [--panel]

WebSocket robot-API server backed by the EXACT firmware (SIL).

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --host HOST
  --port PORT          default 8081 (81 is privileged)
  --gui                show the PyBullet window
  --debug              print contact force diagnostics every 60 frames (1/4 s) + startup check
  --sse-port SSE_PORT  telemetry SSE port (default 8082)
  --panel              also host the browser control panel over HTTP (at the SSE port /panel)
